_comment: REGRESSION SCENARIO: basic single-motor bidirectional DSHOT600 regression - half of the 2x2 basic matrix (1 motor x DSHOT300/600 x uni/bidirectional; see single_channel_unidirectional_300/600.json for the unidirectional half). One bidirectional motor (channel 1) held at a settled throttle, as a client that reads telemetry would run it. A CRC-valid reply only proves the telemetry link - an armed ESC answers with a constant at-rest eRPM (917) even when the motor never starts - so the median eRPM is checked too: at throttle 100 this bench turns at about 21k eRPM. Thresholds sit well below what this bench delivers: about 255 records/s with one bidirectional motor and 225/s with two (Core 0 samples the latest capture, so this is a sampling rate, not the reply rate), a largest gap of 15ms typically and up to 62ms when the SD card flushes, and every sampled decode CRC-valid.
